failures_found_and_fixed_during_implemen: Child argv relative paths resolved against the per-attempt scratch cwd (worker exited 2, no report): diagnosed as a caller-input issue - argv is verbatim per contract; tests pass absolute worker paths.
Poll loop could spin when pending jobs remained but refill was blocked by cancel/deadline: added the empty-active break and terminal sweep.
Repeated child_killed journal spam on cancellation: killed_cause is now set once and the cancel path does not re-terminate.
Unreapable (D-state) children could stall the loop forever: added honest 'abandoned' handling (journal child_unreaped, classified) instead of hanging the run.
Journal seq restarted on resume: Journal counts existing lines and continues the global sequence.
os.fork() rlimit probe fired DeprecationWarning in multi-threaded hosts and could deadlock in the child: probe now runs in a fresh interpreter subprocess (e067442).
macOS injects __CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING at exec regardless of the parent's env: the env-allowlist test accepts documented platform-injected keys and still asserts the parent secret never leaks.

platform_notes.memory_bound_degradation: RLIMIT_AS is rejected by macOS; on this host the memory bound is enforced by the live libproc proc_pidinfo RSS probe plus post-exit wait4 ru_maxrss.
